title: Blender Engine Fabric strengthening with upstream compatibility preservation
decision: Materialize an adapter-first FA3 Blender Engine Fabric around the existing Bforartists-primary DCC architecture. Preserve Blender-native .blend semantics, bpy/RNA/operator and Cycles/EEVEE compatibility; do not create a Blender fork, a competing scene authority, a new .fa3blend format, a new capability, or a new architectural authority. Reuse existing FA3 Render, 3D Geometry, Khronos/OpenUSD, HRB, Model Router, cache, evidence and Current Host structures.
